newsitem.title: USA: Brazos Sportswear says will buy Morning Sun.
newsitem.headline: Brazos Sportswear says will buy Morning Sun.

text.p: Brazos Sportswear Inc said Tuesday it has entered into a letter of intent to acquire Morning Sun Inc, a privately-held, Seattle-based apparel maker.
The company said Morning Sun is a designer and manufacturer of embroidered and screen printed fleece wear, tee-shirts and other women's tops, with annual revenues of about $55 million.
The company said the proposed purchase price is approximately $30 million with the assumption of liabilities of approximately $12 million.

The company said the acquisition is subject to numerous conditions, including regulatory approvals and financing of the transaction, and the parties anticipate that, if the transaction proceeded, a closing would occur by May 31, 1997.
Brazos Sportswear is a manufacturer and distributor of decorated sportswear with annualized revenues of about $250 million.
